name: mindsai-personas
description: Build AI knowledge bases, run multi-perspective research panels, and export branded reports. Train AI on topics, documents, or websites. Survey synthetic expert groups for market research and policy testing.
author: Minds AI

tools.name: list_my_ai_personas
tools.description: List your AI personas (also called: experts, digital twins, consumers, respondents, characters, profiles). Supports fuzzy name search.

tools.name: create_ai_persona_or_digital_twin
tools.description: Create an AI persona / expert / digital twin / consumer character — trained on topics (keywords), a public figure (clone), or a URL (link).

tools.name: talk_to_ai_persona
tools.description: Talk / message / chat with one of your AI personas. Use this for 1:1 conversations — for surveying multiple personas at once, use ask_panel.

tools.name: check_ai_persona_training_progress
tools.description: Check whether an AI persona has finished training. Returns progress percentage and current stage.

tools.name: create_panel
tools.description: Start a research panel / study / survey / focus group with one or more groups of AI personas for comparative analysis.

tools.name: ask_panel
tools.description: Ask / survey / poll a panel any question. Each persona answers; results aggregate per group (mean, dominant choice, theme clusters). Triggers: 'how do they feel', 'what does <panel> think', 'ask the group'.

tools.name: list_panels
tools.description: List your panels (also called: studies, surveys, research projects, focus groups, qual studies, conversations). Supports fuzzy name search.

tools.name: get_panel_status
tools.description: Get a panel's live status — groups, members, in-flight questions, completed results (with per-group breakdowns), and PDF export status.

tools.name: get_panel_analytics
tools.description: Summarize a panel's findings across all questions — mean, distribution, theme clusters, group divergence, scale-question ranking.

tools.name: export_panel
tools.description: Export / download a panel as branded PDF, CSV, Excel, or JSON. PDF is the default polished report.

tools.name: list_groups
tools.description: List your groups (also called: segments, audiences, cohorts) with their member personas.

resources.name: ai-persona-widget
resources.description: Interactive widget for creating and chatting with AI personas
